verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs show budgets and spend limits that can be assigned to departments and teams, with auto-enforced limits that block out-of-policy purchases and automatically routed multi-level approvals. However, the docs never tie budgets to projects or show approvals gating spend against a budget balance, and all evidence is vendor marketing or docs. missing for 10: explicit project-level budget allocation, documented approval enforcement tied to budget consumption, independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them

citations.quote: The budgets API lets you manage your Brex Budgets and Spend Limits.
Manage budgets and spend limits in over 100 currencies and embed localized expense policies to enable spend for entities, individuals, and departments.
Auto-enforced controls empower employees to spend with confidence.
Automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits.
Assign top-line budgets, and track spend instantly
Set rules for how employees can spend, what they need to document, and who needs to approve.
